stem: A technician finds similar leaf-edge damage on plants directly below one fixture but not on the rest of the bench. What is the best next observation step?
choices: Map the affected plants relative to the fixture and compare local light/temperature conditions with unaffected areas
Diagnose nutrient deficiency for the whole room
Prune every damaged leaf before recording location
Ignore the pattern because controller averages are acceptable
rationale: Spatial clustering relative to equipment is useful evidence and should be compared with local environmental conditions.
